text:
Arjun: Kicking off canary for v3.2-lite-q4. Before we open traffic, want agreement on the automated gate rules. Focus: avoid noisy rollbacks but be safe on quality/latency.
Nina: Sounds good. For quality use relative MRR delta with one-sided 95% CI and require at least 1k samples overall. If a small slice shows volatility, we should surface it but avoid auto-rollback unless it explains >20% of overall loss.
Diego: Add a hallucination counter (detected via oracle heuristics) and a semantic concordance metric for longdocs (cosine on holdout). If hallucination_rate + concordance both degrade, escalate fast.
Arjun (config): ```yaml
rules:
  - id: quick-bail
    trigger: all
    checks:
      - metric: mrr_relative_delta
        op: "<"
        value: -0.03
        window: 3m
      - metric: hallucination_rate_delta
        op: ">"
        value: 0.015
        window: 3m
    action: rollback

  - id: soft-cap
    trigger: any
    checks:
      - metric: mrr_relative_delta
        op: "<"
        value: -0.008
        window: 20m
    action: reduce_traffic_to: "10%"

  - id: latency-snag
    trigger: any
    checks:
      - metric: p95_latency_delta_ms
        op: ">"
        value: 60
        window: 2m
    action: route_to_stable
```
Nina: Two tweaks: (1) use 1m mini-window for detection to catch spikes; confirm with the 20m window before hard actions. (2) Apply an empirical-Bayes smoothing on low-count slices.
Diego: Also require that the quick-bail only runs if global sample_count > 1000 in the 3m window; otherwise degrade to soft-cap.
ops-bot: canary started: v3.2-lite-q4 -> 5% traffic at 2025-06-12T14:02:00Z
Elena (SRE): I'll set autoscale buffer +1 GPU to handle KV warmup. I'll watch for lane saturation alerts; please tag me if you flip to 20% so I can bump capacity proactively.
Arjun: Plan: 90m shadow run against longdoc holdout to gather concordance then open 5% canary with these gates. If we hit soft-cap we collect an extra 2h of metrics before manual review.
Nina: If we see sub-1% MRR dips with no hallucination or latency signals, prefer observation and extended shadow instead of immediate action.
Diego: I'll add per-slice weight contributions to the canary report and a quick diff table for the UI.
Arjun: Cheers — will post the rollout-manifest and link the shadow report once ready. :rocket:
